Class Camera.Builder

java.lang.Object
renderer.Camera.Builder
Enclosing class:
Camera
public static class Camera.Builder extends Object
Static inner class implementing the Builder design pattern to securely configure and construct a Camera instance.

    • build

      public Camera build()
      Verifies the validity of all injected data, performs necessary calculations (orthogonality, pixel sizes), and returns the final camera.
      Returns:
      A valid and cloned Camera instance.
      Throws:
      MissingResourceException - If a critical parameter (position, direction) is missing.
      IllegalArgumentException - If geometric data is invalid (negative values, non-orthogonal vectors).
